evidence.description: Report number 24-094918. Date of incident Friday, January 26, 2024. Time not reported. Location given as the 5300 block of Ebell Street, Long Beach, CA. Premises type: residence. Police were called regarding a break-in.

The report states a suspect posed as a salesman or service worker, knocked, and entered when occupants did not appear to be home. The report says police state this for every incident in the series and that it is not specific to this address, so it is not treated as this incident's entry method.
Footage, vehicle, point of entry, damage, and items missing are all recorded as not reported.
